messages.help:
Why: Screen readers announce the title to help users understand the iframe content.
Fix:
  <iframe
  src="https://example.com/video"
  title="Product demo video"
  ></iframe>
Note: The title should describe the content, not the source.
messages.message: [vize:a11y/iframe-has-title] <iframe> elements must have a title attribute

messages.help: Add a sandbox attribute (e.g. sandbox="" for the most restrictive policy) and re-grant only the capabilities the embedded content needs
Ensure URLs are sanitized before binding to prevent XSS via javascript: protocol
messages.message: [vize:vue/no-unsafe-url] Dynamic :src binding may be vulnerable to XSS via javascript: protocol

messages.help:
Security Risk: v-html renders raw HTML and can execute malicious scripts from user input. Alternatives: 1. Use text interpolation (auto-escaped):

{{ userContent }}

2. Use a sanitization library: import DOMPurify from 'dompurify' const safeHtml = DOMPurify.sanitize(userInput) 3. Use a markdown renderer with XSS protection If you must use v-html: - Never use with user-provided content - Only use with trusted, static content
messages.message: [vize:vue/no-v-html] v-html can lead to XSS attacks. Avoid using it with user-provided content
